name: @buun-mail/gateway
description: The Buun Mail gateway: a Cloudflare Email Worker that receives mail for the domains a mailbox owns, holds it until Buun Mail collects it over an authenticated API, and tells connected apps the moment it lands.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/state && wrangler dev --port 28620 --inspector-port 28630 --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env preview --remote
scripts.check:deploy: wrangler deploy --dry-run --env preview && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production
